decision_basis.pilot_feasibility: The five-epoch seed-42 pilot completed with finite training and within the frozen VRAM budget.
decision_basis.pilot_full_cloud_validation: 187 validation buildings, 18.7 million points, three frozen votes; descriptive only.
decision_basis.failed_first_full_cloud_attempt: The first attempt completed inference but failed before metric persistence with KeyError: 'vote_seeds'; the successful retry took 4126.3 seconds on its own.
decision_basis.shape_iou_audit_gap: The pilot artifact does not contain per-building results needed to independently recompute shape IoU.
decision_basis.decision: Prepare an internal multi-seed validation gate; no architecture efficacy claim is authorized by the pilot.

proposed_experiment.purpose: Internal S8 architecture gate against the existing S7 mass-aware MHA validation control.
proposed_experiment.checkpoint_selection: Best fixed-crop validation Part-IoU, earliest epoch on exact ties, before full-cloud evaluation.

full_cloud_validation.primary_metric: global Part-IoU on the full validation clouds
full_cloud_validation.audit_output: Persist per-building confusion matrices or equivalent per-building IoU and class-union data so shape IoU can be recomputed independently.

proposed_experiment.comparison: Pair each S8 seed with the existing S7 mass-aware MHA result of the same seed; the S7 validation results are already known, so this is an internal development gate only.
proposed_experiment.claim_scope: Three seeds support an internal gate only. Any headline claim requires a separate prospective decision with at least five paired seeds.
proposed_experiment.failure_policy: Preserve failures and partial artifacts; do not silently rerun with changed code or parameters. Register any operational fix before retry.

lock_requirements_before_data_access: Implement and test a seed-parameterized S8 training runner with complete checkpoint resume.
Implement and test a validation-only full-cloud evaluator that persists per-building audit data.
Freeze runner, evaluator, model, data, split, S7 control, metric, thresholds, and hardware hashes in a separate preregistration.
Record an explicit post-pilot execution authorization referencing that preregistration.
